holidays.name: Entrance Ceremony
holidays.longDescription: Entrance Ceremony is observed on day 1 of month 1 in the Kivotos Academic Calendar. It is classified as a civic and is associated with Kivotos Academy terms begin . Communities use the occasion to preserve local memory, reinforce shared identity, and mark the passage of the calendar year. Practices vary by region and faction, so this observance may carry different political or religious meaning across the wider world.
